caption: The drawing features a rectangular background in a light brown, beige, and slightly mottled color. In the center is a large, irregular scalloped oval shape outlined in blue, with three large blue-outlined, flower-like shapes attached to the outline at the top, left, and bottom. The interior of the scalloped shape contains text in uppercase serif letters, also in blue, reading from top to bottom: "C. CROLIUS MANUFACTURER MANHATTAN WELLS NEW YORK." The letters are evenly spaced and well-aligned in horizontal rows. The overall composition centers the text and the ornamental shapes within the rectangular frame. At the lower left of the rectangle, on the white area surrounding the main image, there is a faint pencil signature reading "Chas Cross." The style is simple, with the use of muted earth tones and blue as the accent color.
